subject.title: feat: Plugin API for TUI footer status contributions (registerStatusProvider)

question: Should OpenClaw add a public plugin status-provider SDK seam for TUI footer contributions now, and if so what contract shape should be accepted?
rationale: This changes the public Plugin SDK and the TUI extension boundary; automation can verify an implementation, but maintainers need to choose whether this API belongs in core and which naming/return/rendering contract becomes durable.

options.title: Approve a narrow SDK seam
options.body: Refresh and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557 as the API/registry-only implementation, with final maintainer choices on method name, return type, multiplicity, and deferred TUI rendering rules.

options.title: Fold into broader footer design
options.body: Pause this issue until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53774 settles the general footer model, then decide whether a plugin API is still needed.

options.title: Decline core API for now
options.body: Close the linked PR direction and ask ContextClaw or similar plugins to stay outside the TUI footer until a stronger core extension requirement appears.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow SDK seam
recommendation.body: Refresh and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557 as the API/registry-only implementation, with final maintainer choices on method name, return type, multiplicity, and deferred TUI rendering rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested change is a public plugin-architecture decision, and Peter Steinberger introduced the plugin architecture plus has relevant TUI footer history.
